programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Apollo Robbins: The art of misdirection
programme.desc: Hailed as the greatest pickpocket in the world, Apollo Robbins studies the quirks of human behavior as he steals your watch. In a hilarious demonstration, Robbins samples the buffet of the TEDGlobal 2013 audience, showing how the flaws in our perception make it possible to swipe a wallet and leave it on its owner’s shoulder while they remain clueless.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Ben Wellington: How we found the worst place to park in New York City -- using big data
programme.desc: City agencies have access to a wealth of data and statistics reflecting every part of urban life. But as data analyst Ben Wellington suggests in this entertaining talk, sometimes they just don't know what to do with it. He shows how a combination of unexpected questions and smart data crunching can produce strangely useful insights, and shares tips on how to release large sets of data so that anyone can use them.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Brian Greene: Is our universe the only universe?
programme.desc: Is there more than one universe? In this visually rich, action-packed talk, Brian Greene shows how the unanswered questions of physics (starting with a big one: What caused the Big Bang?) have led to the theory that our own universe is just one of many in the "multiverse."TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Laura Snyder: The Philosophical Breakfast Club
programme.desc: In 1812, four men at Cambridge University met for breakfast. What began as an impassioned meal grew into a new scientific revolution, in which these men -- who called themselves “natural philosophers” until they later coined “scientist” -- introduced four major principles into scientific inquiry. Historian and philosopher Laura Snyder tells their intriguing story.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Christopher Soghoian: A brief history of phone wiretapping -- and how to avoid it
programme.desc: Who is listening in on your phone calls? On a landline, it could be anyone, says privacy activist Christopher Soghoian, because surveillance backdoors are built into the phone system by default, to allow governments to listen in. But then again, so could a foreign intelligence service ... or a criminal. Which is why, says Soghoian, some tech companies are resisting governments' call to build the same backdoors into mobile phones and new messaging systems. Learn how some tech companies are working to keep your calls and messages private.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Michael Green: What the Social Progress Index can reveal about your country
programme.desc: The term Gross Domestic Product is often talked about as if it were “handed down from god on tablets of stone.” But this concept was invented by an economist in the 1930s. We need a more effective measurement tool to match 21st century needs, says Michael Green: the Social Progress Index. With charm and wit, he shows how this tool measures societies across the three dimensions that actually matter. And reveals the dramatic reordering of nations that occurs when you use it.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: OpenStack og drift i nettskyen
programme.desc: Dag Stenstad fra Zetta.IO presenterer hvordan man kommer igang med drift av tjenester i nettskyen. De siste årene har skjedd en stor omveltning i den globale IT-bransjen, hvor IT-infrastruktur blir industrialisert og standardisert. Dette legger grunnlaget for helt andre drifts- og utviklingsmodeller enn det som benyttes i dag. Automatisering av oppsett og styring av kapasitet, gjør at fokus endres fra det å drifte enkelte servere, til å levere tjenester.Dag er daglig leder i Zetta.IO, den første norske leverandøren av Infrastruktur som tjeneste (IaaS) levert på Openstack. Han har 16 års erfaring fra telco- og hostingbransjen.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Tania Simoncelli: How I took on the gene patent industry -- and won
programme.desc: Are human genes patentable? Back in 2005, when Tania Simoncelli first contemplated this complex question, US patent law said they were — which meant patent holders had the right to stop anyone from sequencing, testing or even looking at a patented gene. Troubled by the way this law both harmed patients and created a barrier to biomedical innovation, Simoncelli and her colleagues at the ACLU challenged it. In this riveting talk, hear the story of how they took a case everybody told them they would lose all the way to the Supreme Court.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Nancy Lublin: Texting that saves lives
programme.desc: When Nancy Lublin started texting teenagers to help with her social advocacy organization, what she found was shocking -- they started texting back about their own problems, from bullying to depression to abuse. So she's setting up a text-only crisis line, and the results might be even more important than she expected.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Open Source in Broadcasting
programme.desc: For a variety of reasons broadcasters are not big users of open source - if anything many still have a viewpoint of Open Source that resembles views of the early 1990s. This presentation aims to explain what broadcasters around the world are doing in this area and what some of the difficulties are in an industry reliant on proprietary hardware and software as well as IPR-heavy. In particular it will look into the creation of the Open Broadcast Encoder (OBE), a professional television encoder running on commodity hardware which many Norwegian organisations have played a role in. Many of the deployments have been firsts for Open Source in broadcasting, not to mention software encoders, silencing many naysayers.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Dame Ellen MacArthur: The surprising thing I learned sailing solo around the world
programme.desc: What do you learn when you sail around the world on your own? When solo sailor Ellen MacArthur circled the globe – carrying everything she needed with her – she came back with new insight into the way the world works, as a place of interlocking cycles and finite resources, where the decisions we make today affect what's left for tomorrow. She proposes a bold new way to see the world's economic systems: not as linear, but as circular, where everything comes around.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.sub-title: Andreas Ekström: The moral bias behind your search results
programme.desc: Search engines have become our most trusted sources of information and arbiters of truth. But can we ever get an unbiased search result? programme.title: Civic Tech and the Sad Story of Freedom of Information in Hungary
programme.desc: «Átlátszó,» the word means «transparent» in Hungarian, and it is the name of Hungary's first independent investigative journalism website. A watchdog non-government organisation (NGO) which has experimented with introducing Civic Tech solutions in order to facilitate the work of its team, and also to provide citizens with empowering tools. Since Atlatszo.hu was launched in 2011, the Freedom of Information Act has received a lot of attention, and the legal way for questioning public bodies about spending, a «Freedom of Information request» has become the tool for many to reveal information about corruption.Marietta Le will showcase the use of the free software system Alaveteli, and the use of the Freedom of Information Act in Hungary. The law has been changed since 2011, and the latest news is about a threat that would make access to information much harder for Hungarian citizens. Meanwhile, Atlatszo.hu and many others are trying to implement new Civic Tech solutions in Hungary to help people exercise their democratic rights.Marietta Le is an FOI advocate at Atlatszo.hu Hungarian investigative journalism website. She also works with the K-Monitor anti-corruption NGO as a project coordinator to «Be Smart with Data», a program that facilitates NGOs in producing web apps and visualisations using open data. In 2015 the Hungarian Forbes magazine has featured her on their «30 under 30» list for starting «Jarokelo.hu», a street fixing website in Hungary.

programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Anand Varma: A thrilling look at the first 21 days of a bee’s life
programme.desc: We’ve heard that bees are disappearing. But what is making bee colonies so vulnerable? Photographer Anand Varma raised bees in his backyard — in front of a camera — to get an up close view. This project, for National Geographic, gives a lyrical glimpse into a bee hive — and reveals one of the biggest threats to its health, a mite that preys on baby bees in the first 21 days of life. With his incredible footage, set to music from Magik*Magik Orchestra, Varma shows the problem ... and what’s being done to solve it. (This talk was part of a session at TED2015 guest-curated by Pop-Up Magazine: popupmagazine.com or @popupmag on Twitter.)TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.desc: Oljefondets rolle i Israels folkemord«Den norske staten risikerer å bli dømt for medvirkning til folkemord og krigsforbrytelser i internasjonale domstoler», skriver Øyvind Andresen i siste utgave av avisa Ny Tid. Han er gjest i denne episoden av Medieovervåkerne.Gjennom Oljefondet har Norge økt sine investeringer i Israel etter at Israel startet sine barbariske myrderier på palestinerne i Gaza i oktober 2023. I artikkelen dokumenteres det at oljefondet har økt sine investeringer med 35 % i selskaper som er involvert i Israels krigsforbrytelser, okkupasjoner og folkerettsbrudd. Oljefondet er f.eks. Europas største investor i selskaper som opererer på den okkuperte Vestbredden. «Oljefondet er en del av den kapitalistiske drapsmaskinen», sier Øyvind Andresen.

programme.desc: While we like to imagine little green men, it’s far more likely that life on other planets will be microbial. Planetary scientist Nathalie Cabrol takes us inside the search for microbes on Mars, a hunt which counterintuitively leads us to the remote lakes of the Andes mountains. This extreme environment — with its thin atmosphere and scorched land — approximates the surface of Mars about 3.5 billion years ago. How microbes adapt to survive here may just show us where to look on Mars — and could help us understand why some microbial pathways lead to civilization while others are a dead end.TED talk downloaded from The Internet Archive.

programme.title: Herlige hjem
programme.desc: Marianne eier og driver Instagramkontoen @inspirasjonsguidennorge med over 150.000 følgere. En del av jobben er å inspirere sine følgere, og derfor er det essensielt at hun kan være stolt av interiørdesignet hun har i sitt eget hjem – et funkishus i Oslo fra 1952. I et blått sveitserhus fra 1860 - som ble bygget av den første baker Samson - bor Gjyri Helen Werp med familien sin på Ormøya, med utsikt over hele Oslofjorden. Dette er damen som gjør alt selv!

programme.title: Big Cat Country

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Spor løvens fremvekst fra forhistorisk rovdyr til moderne regent når vitenskapen avslører kampene, båndene og de brutale overlevelsesstrategiene som har formet denne ikoniske, afrikanske jegeren. La deg rive med i løvenes drama og risikofylte jakt.

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Konfronter havets mest allsidige og formidable rovdyr. Lær om de biologiske fordelene som hjalp denne forhistoriske arten med å overleve flere masseutryddelser, og la deg imponere av oksehaienes utrettelige jaktferdigheter.

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Få et gjensyn med brunbjørnens evolusjonære reise, fra dens forfedre som dominerte under istiden til dagens moderne altetere. Vær vitne til deres symbiotiske forhold til laks og de overraskende sammenflettede økosystemene de lever i.

programme.title: Sultlekene: Alaskas store bjørneutfordring
programme.desc: Våkn opp fra dvalen med 7 glupske bjørner når fase 1 av konkurransen går i gang. Kjemp mot ulver med den nybakte moren BoldFace, og se lille Stomper kjempe om makt og Blondies kjærlighet. Ta et skritt bakover når Bernie sloss med tenåringen Casanova.

programme.title: Sultlekene: Alaskas store bjørneutfordring
programme.desc: Bli med på den desperate sprinten for å få kloa i julilaksen med vinnerne av fase 1 og noen tøffe, nye rekrutter. Følg BigBoi tur for å finne mat, ønsk QuadMom og RedBack velkommen til etegildet, og se om BoldFace kan passe på valpen sin.

programme.title: Sultlekene: Alaskas store bjørneutfordring
programme.sub-title: Farvel, og takk for all fisken
programme.desc: Pakk deg godt inn når en kald oktoberstorm gjør det vanskeligere å nå målstreken. Se Big Boi stikke etter et fall før tragedien treffer QuadMom. Hei mens storfavoritten BoldFace finner godformen på tross av ungen, Racoon. Men hvem får bære kronen?

programme.title: Dyrevern i byen
programme.desc: En minkunge blir forlatt i en butikk, og teamet trår til med adferdstrening. Men vil denne søte karen bli tøff nok for villmarken når de er ferdige? En prærieulv som har fått skabb, får litt alenetid til å bli frisk igjen.

programme.title: Fantastiske dyrevenner
programme.desc: Møt flere fantastiske dyrevenner, deriblant en valp på et dyremottak som hjelper en gepard i fangenskap med å bli klar til å slippes fri, en skadet ape som blir venner med en flokk uvennlige hunder, og en enslig mangust som liker å finne mat sammen med en flokk sauer.

programme.title: Primatenes rike
programme.desc: For millioner av år siden strandet flere dyr på Madagaskars forrevne kyst. Nykommerne var isolert fra fastlandet og ble nødt til å tilpasse seg. Dette er en magisk verden full av sjeldne og unike dyr som har tilpasset seg det tropiske paradiset perfekt.

programme.title: Primatenes rike
programme.desc: Madagaskar er lemurenes land. Lemurer er fascinerende primitive primater som lever i trærne på øya. De finnes i alle størrelser, farger og former, fra de største indriene til den bittelille muselemuren.

programme.title: Primatenes rike
programme.desc: Denne historien utspiller seg i den lille landsbyen Hogsback på toppen av et fjell i Østkapp i Sør-Afrika. På grunn av tap av habitat og splittelse har blåapene og gladiatorpapegøyene i de nærliggende skogene vært nødt til å lete etter mat utenfor sine naturlige områder, og i stedet begi seg inn i landsbyen hver dag.

programme.title: Primatenes rike
programme.desc: Med sitt høye antall individer, tilpasningsdyktighet og intelligente lederskap er bavianflokken i Bambelela et utmerket eksempel på hvorfor bavianer trives i hele Afrika. Den svært sofistikerte sosiale adferden og organiseringen gjenspeiler mye av menneskenes samfunn, og viser hvor like vi er våre apeslektninger.

programme.title: Vombatenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: I det kjølige høylandet i nærheten av Snowy Mountains i Australia ligger Vombatskogen. Her, blant trærne og det tette løvverket, finnes over hundre vombathi. Men når noen av hiene blir oversvømt, må vombatene komme seg i sikkerhet.

programme.title: Vombatenes hemmelige liv
programme.desc: Vombater er enslige, trege dyr, men under paringstiden blir de både energiske, aggressive og lekne. Møt en sørlig hårete vombat ved navn Birri, som prøver å finne en make, samt hunnen Winnie og ungen hennes, Fred.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: Dette er den utrolige historien om en tresort som har eksistert i 800 år, tåler selv de tøffeste forhold og er mer populært blant insekter, fugler og dyr enn noe annet – det enorme apebrødtreet som lever på savannen i Malilangwe viltreservat i det sørlige Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Dyreakutten
programme.desc: Akutteamet behandler en veritabel vårflom av pasienter. Dyrlege Phil stabiliserer en syk kenguruunge, mens bergingsteamet holder en frekk kenguru unna. Den erfarne dyrlegen Tim behandler en punggrevling som har blitt kloret av en katt, og manøvrerer en slange ut av en rist.

programme.title: Dyreakutten
programme.desc: Bergingsarbeider Jo henter en pelikan som har svelget en fiskekrok, og Sam hjelper en nyfødt flaggermus som sitter fast i et gjerde. Dyrlege Tim hjelper en gretten koala med en øyeinfeksjon, og en klumpete pytonslange skaper masse trøbbel for nykommer Ruby.

programme.title: Dyreakutten
programme.desc: Dyrlege Bec behandler koalaen Rachel, som har blitt bitt av en hund. De nye dyrlegene Ruby og Kerryn hjelper en flokk pungrotter med kløe. Redningsarbeider Dani befrir to koookaburraer som sitter fast, og dyrlege Tim opererer kneet til en småsvever.

programme.title: Dyreakutten
programme.desc: Teamet behandler pasienter etter et tilfelle av dyrehamstring, og redningsarbeiderne Jo og Chantelle redder en ibis som sitter fast. Dyrlege Mel tar seg av en koalaunge som har tatt et svalestup, og vi møter en dødelig brunsnok.

programme.title: 13 timer til å overleve
programme.desc: Gå ned i tidevannsbassenget der et eremittkrabbehus er på jakt, en katthai løper inn til fremmede naboer, og en blekksprut terroriserer byttedyr. Se måker og andre skapninger jakte på overflaten når varmen stiger og oksygen tømmes i bassenget.

programme.title: 13 timer til å overleve
programme.desc: Tell ned sekundene mens solen går ned og rovdyrene sniker seg rundt bassenget før tidevannet endelig kommer sigende. Hold ut når natten kommer med en kleptoman snegle og et akrobatisk kamskjell, mens to slu krabber gjør et farlig forsøk på romantikk.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: Ved vannkanten samles en gruppe modige hannpingviner for å forberede den farlige reisen på land. Mange farer ligger foran dem, men det er trygghet i å være flere, og disse små pingvinene har et viktig ærend å utføre. Det er paringstid, og de må finne et hi før hunnene kommer.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: Vestkysten av New Zealand er forskjellig fra alle andre steder på jorden. Det utrolige landskapet har alt fra isdekte fjell til regnvåte skoger og opprørt, iskaldt hav. Denne nesten uberørte villmarken er isolert fra resten av verden, og skjuler en rekke stedegne dyr. De er strandet her, og evolusjonen har sørget for at alle er en sjelden økologisk juvel, fra keaer og sky pingviner til pattedyraktige kivier og eldgamle åler. For å klare seg i disse forholdene må dyrene være hardføre, smarte og snarrådige. En reise langs vestkysten viser hvor vakkert dette landet er, og avslører prøvelsene til dyrene som holder til her.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: På New Zealand beskytter to villmarksfestninger de sårbare dyrene som er naturlig hjemmehørende her. Den ene er en øde øy som er beskyttet av en vollgrav med saltvann, den andre et tilfluktssted på en bakketopp omgitt av en rovdyrsikker barriere. Dette er historien om disse ømfintlige fristedene og dyrelivet som blomstrer på innsiden.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: Våren på østkysten av New Zealand bringer lovnader for pelsselen og kongealbatrossen. De har kommet tilbake til hjemstedet for å yngle, men vanskelig terreng, uforutsigbart vær og sultne rovdyr gjør livet vanskelig for dem. Det er bare de sterkeste som overlever og kan videreføre arven.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: De isolerte øyene på New Zealand er berømte for å være et uvanlig paradis der det finnes en rekke unike dyr. En nærmere titt viser en annen verden som er mest kjent for fugler som ikke kan fly, eldgamle reptiler og pattedyr som lever langs kysten. Dette er et land fullt av miniatyrmonstre, bittesmå rovdyr og trusler med en bemerkelsesverdig tilværelse, der jegerne også blir jaktet på, og livet er en evig kamp for å overleve. Bli med inn i underskogen og oppdag livet i en ny skala. Fra digre kjøttetende skolopendere og nattaktive gresshopper til edderkopper som fisker, og glødende ormer med feller av silke. Disse ukjente skapningene er både rare og flotte, og de nifseste krypdyrene på det villeste New Zealand.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: De isolerte øyene på New Zealand er berømte for å være et uvanlig paradis der det finnes en rekke unike dyr. En nærmere titt viser en annen verden som er mest kjent for fugler som ikke kan fly, eldgamle reptiler og pattedyr som lever langs kysten. Dette er et land fullt av miniatyrmonstre, bittesmå rovdyr og trusler med en bemerkelsesverdig tilværelse, der jegerne også blir jaktet på, og livet er en evig kamp for å overleve. Bli med inn i underskogen og oppdag livet i en ny skala. Fra digre kjøttetende skolopendere og nattaktive gresshopper til edderkopper som fisker, og glødende ormer med feller av silke. Disse ukjente skapningene er både rare og flotte, og de nifseste krypdyrene på det villeste New Zealand.

programme.title: Dyrevern i byen
programme.desc: En nysgjerrig vaskebjørn stikker hodet litt for langt inn i en krukke med peanøttsmør på en stekende sommerdag i Toronto. Se hvordan teamet får ham ut av denne kinkige situasjonen. En gullskilpadde må ha en øyeoperasjon.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Bøy deg i støvet for en av naturens eldste og farligste utholdenhetsrovdyr. Se tigerhaier utnytte kaoset når skilpadder legger egg, overlev oksygenfattige områder med epauletthaier, og motstå det knusende trykket fra dypet med havmusene.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Trål havet med alle slags haier, og se hvorfor disse rovfiskene er overlegne under havoverflaten. Finn veien gjennom korallabyrinter med revhaier, ligg på lur for det perfekte angrepet med skjegghaier, og dra på en episk forflytning med hvithaiene.

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Konfronter havets mest allsidige og formidable rovdyr. Lær om de biologiske fordelene som hjalp denne forhistoriske arten med å overleve flere masseutryddelser, og la deg imponere av oksehaienes utrettelige jaktferdigheter.

programme.title: Sjefshai
programme.desc: Se den ultimate kampen for dominans mens vitenskapsmenn prøver å identifisere alfahannen i en flokk på over 100 hvithaier ved kysten av New Zealand. Bli imponert av hastigheten, jaktferdighetene og fryktløsheten som avgjør hvem som skal lede flokken.

programme.title: Sjefshai: Kjønnskampen
programme.desc: Vær vitne til en annerledes haikonkurranse, der hvithaier stilles mot hverandre i en utrolig styrketest. Sett alt på spill med haispesialist Dr. Riley Elliott når han prøver å finne svar på et eldgammelt spørsmål: Hvilket kjønn er det beste?

programme.title: Afrikas naturparker
programme.desc: I en park der hav møter land, kombineres naturelementene og skaper et fantastisk mangfold. Colafarget vann gjør skogene grønne og tette. Ild og vind fører til vekst, og steiner former en mangefasettert kystlinje. Her blomstrer livet, fra det storslåtte til det bisarre. Dette er Garden Route nasjonalpark.

programme.title: Dyreakutten
programme.desc: Bli med på innsamling av andunger som slåss, og finn ut om dyrlege Karina må hente inn spesialister for å behandle koalaen Spikes beinbrudd. Maurpinnsvinungene Ping og Pong har problemer med magen, og koalaen Jarrah ser ut til å ha gått seg bort.

programme.title: Mozart: Piano Concerto no. 12 - Vladimir Ashkenazy
programme.desc: The 13-part Mozart on Tour series chronicles the journey of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart across Europe. This broadcast features the first three episodes of this series, taking us to London, Mantua, and Bologna. In the first episode, Vladimir Ashkenazy performs as both soloist and conductor in Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 12, KV 414, accompanied by the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra. The second episode features soloist Heidrun Holtmann as she performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 1, KV 37, and Piano Concerto No. 4, KV 41. Holtmann is accompanied by the Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera, led by Marc Andreae. In the third episode, Andreae and his orchestra return for a performance of Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 5, KV 175, featuring Malcolm Frager as the soloist.

programme.title: David Oistrakh: Artist of the People?
programme.desc: The dramatic story of an inspired violinist, of a loyal man whose self-imposed silence eloquently betrayed unspoken private suffering. This extensive profile features interviews with David Oistrakh's longtime friends and fellow musicians: Yehudi Menuhin showing what it takes to make a great violinist; Mstislav Rostropovitch talking of Oistrakh's relationship with the Soviet regime; Gidon Kremer recalling Oistrakh as a teacher; Gennady Rozhdestvensky who conducted all the major concertos for him.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado & Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782. The composer made some revisions in the following year, adding multiple instruments and conducted the premiere of the four-movement piece on March 23, 1783, in Vienna. The “Haffner” Symphony, as it is known now, is a transitional work in Mozart’s career. The work was meant to be party music for Salzburg and was transformed into a symphony for Vienna.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Théodore Géricault. You will discover his labour with An Officer of the Imperial horse guards, Heroic landscape with fisherman or The Horse race.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Amedeo Modigliani. You will discover his labour with Caryatid, Lolotte or others portraits.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover the masterpieces by Gustave Moreau (1826-1898) on display at the Musée d'Orsay, the Gustave Moreau Museum in Paris...

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: With his considerable production of more than 6,000 works, Auguste Renoir took part in the emergence of the impressionist movement even if he were to distance himself from it later to assert a more personal style. This visit begins with his most famous masterpiece, the “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”. You will also rediscover the “Dance in the City” and the “Piano Lesson” exposed at the Joslyn art museum as well as “Claude Renoir in Clown Costume”, a portrait of his son who was later to become one of France’s greatest film directors exposed at the Orangerie Museum in France Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Le bâtiment de la Caisse d'Épargne de Vienne, œuvre de l'architecte Otto Wagner, est un exemple emblématique de l'Art nouveau viennois. Construit entre 1904 et 1912, il se distingue par son design fonctionnel et son utilisation de matériaux modernes comme le verre et l'acier. La façade, épurée et ornée de motifs géométriques, reflète la volonté de Wagner d'allier esthétisme et utilité. L'intérieur est également innovant avec ses vastes espaces ouverts, conçus pour améliorer la ventilation et la circulation de la lumière naturelle. Ce bâtiment représente une synthèse entre tradition et modernité, posant les bases de l'architecture moderne européenne.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Villa Dall’Ava, designed by Rem Koolhaas in 1991, is an iconic project located on the heights of Saint-Cloud, near Paris. This house is distinguished by its bold architecture and geometric forms that challenge the traditional conventions of a typical villa. The structure consists of shifted volumes, with two apartment boxes appearing to float above the pool, creating an impression of lightness.Koolhaas faced significant technical and aesthetic challenges during the design of the villa. On one hand, he dealt with opposition from neighbors concerned about the visual and structural impact of the house on the surrounding landscape. On the other hand, he had to devise ingenious solutions to support the weight of the boxes and the pool, which holds 65 tons of water. The villa incorporates carefully planned internal supports and a drainage system to ensure the stability of the structure.In addition to these challenges, Villa Dall’Ava serves as a reflection on modern living and the rel.

programme.title: Decoding da Vinci
programme.desc: In 2019, the 500th anniversary of the death of Leonardo da Vinci was celebrated. To mark the occasion, the Louvre has organised a major exhibition on the work of the most famous Renaissance painter, starting in October. Echoing this event and based on the latest historiographical research, this documentary offers a new deciphering of the Tuscan master's paintings, revealing through them what painting represented for Leonardo: a philosophy, a total art in the service of understanding the world.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Léonard de Vinci est l’un des artistes les plus adulés au monde. De nombreux films et séries documentaires se sont intéressés à son génie hors du commun, sans pour autant prêter attention à ce qu’il y a de plus parlant : son art. Les tableaux et dessins incomparables de Léonard de Vinci seront au centre de notre film et Exhibition on screen vous présentera la totalité des tableaux qui lui sont attribués. Marquant les 500 ans de la mort de ce génie, ce documentaire est une référence sur Léonard de Vinci, le premier à raconter son histoire dans sa globalité.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Goya: Visions of Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considéré comme le fondateur de l’art moderne, est l’artiste espagnol le plus acclamé. En plus d’observer avec talent la vie et le passé mouvementé de l’Espagne, c’est un portraitiste doué et un commentateur social par excellence. Avec Goya, l’art du portrait atteint de nouveaux sommets. Cette exposition majeure de la National Gallery de Londres remet son génie en lumière. À travers une formidable collection d’oeuvres uniques et de lettres de Goya, nous analysons l’homme lui-même et le monde qu’il peignait.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted in 1911, Pablo Picasso’s "La Coiffeuse" is an iconic work of Cubism. The painting was last seen in 1998, following a loan for an exhibition in Munich. On its return to Paris, it was stored in the Centre Pompidou’s storerooms… until the day it was discovered to be missing, in 2001. Had it been stolen from the storerooms? Sixteen years after the theft, in 2014, a ship docked at the port of Newark, in New Jersey, USA. The artwork was on board….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: David Hockney à la Royal Academy of Arts
programme.desc: David Hockney, généralement considéré comme l’un des artistes britanniques les plus populaires, connaît un succès mondial grâce à ses expositions à Londres, New York, Paris et ailleurs qui attirent des millions de spectateurs. Devenu récemment octogénaire, Hockney ne semble pas avoir l’intention de lever le pied ni de perdre son audace légendaire. Ce film révèle des interviews intimes et inédites et se concentre sur deux expositions à succès ayant eu lieu en 2012 et 2016 à la Royal Academy of Arts Londres. Le réalisateur Phil Grabsky a bénéficié d’un accès privilégié pour célébrer sur grand écran ce génie créatif du XXIe siècle.

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.sub-title: Qiu Xiaoqiu and His Shagrila School
programme.desc: A lover of Tibet and high mountains, painter Qiu Xiaoqiu has made more than twenty journeys across the Tibetan highlands. He brought back striking portraits of nomads wandering through the mineral vastness of the Himalayas. The first Chinese artist to paint animals in their natural habitat, one of his works depicting pandas inspired the world-famous WWF logo.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In about 1560, in Maser, the Barbaro brothers, members of one of the most important Venetian families, asked the architect Andrea Palladio to build them a country house and the painter Paolo Veronese to decorate the walls. Andrea Palladio, a former stonemason, had become the favourite architect of the Venetian aristocracy and invent a new type of country residence, half palazzo, half farm, known as a Villa. The palladian villa is a revolution. For the first time, Architecture must also consider habitation and daily usage in trying to marry beauty with utility, for a new architectural ambition and a new concept of beauty. Some thirty of these prestigious houses were built in Venetia between 1550 and 1580, Andrea Palladio define the basis for all oderly and geometric occidental architecture. In front of the rationnalist work of Palladio, the Veronése frescoes which decorate the villa Barbaro are a trompe l’œil type of illusion, play to open imaginary doors and windows everywhere and inse.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Pierre Bonnard. You will discover his labour with Woman dozing on a bed, Summer in Normandy or The beach in low tide.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Caravaggio. You will discover his labour with Bacchus, Mary Magdalene or Christ at the Column.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Between 1883 and 1926 Claude Monet lived in a house at Giverny where he created a flower garden and a water garden, which provided the inspiration for his series of paintings known as the “Water Lilies”. The “Water-Lily Pond” portrays this garden, with its water lilies and the Japanese bridge in the background. In the series of eight large canvases on the theme, housed in the Musée de l’Orangerie in Paris, Monet introduces variations in light according to the hour of the day.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: L'hôtel Van Eetvelde, une maison particulière de trois étages, construite entre 1895 et 1897, à Bruxelles, Avenue Palmerston. L'homme qui l'a fait construire: Edmond Van Eetvelde, un haut fonctionnaire dont la carrière est en pleine ascension. Pour construire sa maison, Van Eetvelde choisit Victor Horta, un jeune archi-tecte d'avant garde, l'un des créateurs du mouvement de l'art nouveau.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: C’est l’un des artistes les plus controversés et pourtant, l’un des plus influents. La collection de Picasso contenait principalement des Renoir. Matisse le vénérait. Monet également. Renoir a été crucial dans la création du mouvement impressionniste, avant de le rejeter totalement pour se lancer dans un genre radicalement différent, avec beaucoup de succès. La Collection Barnes à Philadelphie possède plus de toiles de Renoir que n’importe quelle autre galerie au monde et c’est là que nous tenterons de lever le voile sur l’histoire remarquable de cet incroyable artiste.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: The man with the long greying beard who we find in this self-portrait is the painter Camille Pissarro (1830-1903). A keen follower of the Impressionist movement, the artist specialised in landscapes around Paris, often painted in winter, such as the “Chestnut Tress at Louveciennes” or the urban landscapes of Montmartre. Towards the end of his life, his painting technique changed and he turned towards Neo-Impressionism, for example in the “Seine River and Louvre Palace”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discuss with Simon Guillemin, photographer and director. He was born and raised in Brittany, and at the age of 23 he undertook a big trip to discover other countries and took his camera with him. When he returned to France, he started working for news agencies and was interested in current affairs. He then turned to more human subjects, notably natural disasters such as the earthquake in Nepal.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'humoriste et animateur Jim Moir et sa femme Nancy Sorrell partent en road trip dans le Kent aujourd'hui.Mieux connu sous le nom de Vic Reeves, Jim apporte sa touche d'humour unique à l'achat d'antiquités. De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Karel Appel’s father forced him to take over the hairdressing business, but Karel only wanted one thing: to become a painter. And he did: A great master ahead of his time, a world famous painter even. In 1949, when he was still unknown and penniless, he made "Child, Church, Animal". Actually nothing is known about the construction of this painting. Not more than you can discover at first sight. To find out more, we have to take a closer look at the work using a microscope. It seems as if the work consists of several layers.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted in 1911, Pablo Picasso’s "La Coiffeuse" is an iconic work of Cubism. The painting was last seen in 1998, following a loan for an exhibition in Munich. On its return to Paris, it was stored in the Centre Pompidou’s storerooms… until the day it was discovered to be missing, in 2001. Had it been stolen from the storerooms? Sixteen years after the theft, in 2014, a ship docked at the port of Newark, in New Jersey, USA. The artwork was on board….

programme.title: China - Masters of the Arts
programme.desc: When Chinese painting and its ancestral codes travel the world, Wang Xijing, a master of shan shui landscape painting, becomes an ethnographer, portraying the peoples of Africa, conflicts in Syria, and modern migration routes. Rooted in the highest Chinese pictorial tradition, he captures the types and energies of other peoples using ancestral techniques. Through Wang Xijing’s works, we journey across the globe, guided by the grace of Chinese humanist thought and philosophy.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Genre pictural existant depuis l’Antiquité, la nature morte connut un regain d’intérêt à partir du XVIIe siècle dans la peinture européenne. Représentation composée d’éléments inanimés, elle peut se limiter à la table d’un repas, comme dans le frugal Dessert de gaufrettes de Lubin Baugin, ou d’animaux chassés comme dans la Nature morte au faisan de Jean-Baptiste Oudry. Retrouvez également des natures mortes célèbres de Chardin, Cézanne et Van Gogh.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le nouveau maire de Sendai développe le projet d’une médiathèque, un type de bâtiment jusqu’alors inconnu au Japon. Son architecte Toyo ito rompt avec les postulats de l’architecture moderne du 20 ème siècle : la médiathèque et son « espace sans barrières » est un premier pas vers une architecture immatérielle et évanescente, laissant toute sa place à l’éphémère.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates Stéphany Mora and Harleena will compete on an imposed theme. Today, the theme is vineyards. They will have one hour to take the best picture possible. Let’s see who will win.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: C’est dans le centre de Buenos Aires qu’Eduardo Stupia a décidé d’installer son atelier entièrement dédié à la création. Dans une maison du XXe siècle, coincé entre deux immeubles modernes, il occupe un large espace dans lequel il peut se livrer à son art de prédilection, le dessin. Ses œuvres, qu’il décrit lui-même comme des paysages abstraits, sont tracées au crayon, au fusain, ou à l’encre de Chine. Dans ses compositions hétéroclites, où le langage graphique et la précision du geste tiennent une place centrale, Eduardo Stupia explore la sémantique du dessin et ouvre le champ de l’imagination.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: It's the long-awaited day of the grand final. But before seeing the reaction of the owners and finding out their scores, each candidate will find out what the other contestants thought of their choice in terms of decoration. And it's Armand who will be the first to join our decorating expert, Valérie Damidot, in the workshop. Armand is about to discover the criticisms of his opponents. We hope for his sake that his heart is in the right place.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Now it's time to give it their all on the construction sites, in a bid to win the coveted title of decorating ace. And it's Cédric who's going to take the plunge in this competition. At 38, this native of Namur is passionate about decoration. He talks decor, thinks decor, lives decor. Cédric shares his passion for decoration with his husband Mickaël, a partner who knows better than anyone how much of a perfectionist he is.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in the name of sustainable development and environmental protection. He shows us the incredible wealth of our planet and goes to meet those who propose solutions to perpetuate farming and cultivation models. We discover how to feed ourselves without destroying in the Rhône-Alpes region, how to preserve the forest in Indonesia, but also the extent of GMOs in Alsace as well as the advantages of terroir in Provence-Alpes-Côte-D'azur.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo met l'avocat à l'honneur, ce fruit originaire du Mexique qui présente de nombreux bienfaits pour notre santé. Elle nous propose une recette de gambas à la purée de concombres et avocats, ainsi qu'une panna cotta à l'avocat accompagnée de sa salade de fraises.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Les apéros improvisés, ce n’est pas toujours facile. Quand les amis débarquent sans prévenir, le stress peut vite monter. Pas de panique, Luana Belmondo et Thomas Clouet, grand spécialiste en la matière, improvisent un apéro au pied levé avec trois fois rien. Des macarons de champignons, un mini tartare de bœuf, et le tour est joué !

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: A land of character, Corrèze is full of hidden treasures. From Collonges-la-Rouge, a flamboyant red sandstone town, to the Cistercian abbey of Aubazine, and through Beaulieu-sur-Dordogne and its medieval heritage, each place bears witness to a rich past. But beyond its monuments, this region is also seductive for its untouched nature and its passionate inhabitants, guardians of an age-old legacy.

programme.desc: C'est parti pour cette nouvelle semaine de compétition. Mais avant de s'affronter chacun leur tour à coups de pinceaux et de marteaux, les quatre décorateurs amateurs ont rendez-vous à Bruxelles, dans l'atelier. C’est l'occasion de jauger la concurrence. La première prétendante au titre d’As de la Déco, c'est Adeline. Du haut de ses 26 ans, la jeune femme est gérante d'une boutique de vêtements en ligne. La mode et les tendances, c'est son dada... ce qui fait d’elle une concurrente redoutable !

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of Home Training features an intense cardio workout. Guillaume and Sabrina guide you through a series of exercises, including high knees, lunges, and lateral movements. The focus is on endurance and energy burn, with dynamic moves engaging the entire body. As always, they emphasize the importance of warming up and staying hydrated for a safe session. Get ready to sweat and boost your cardio in a fun and motivating atmosphere!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Yoga
programme.desc: Practice Yoga from the comfort of your home with our experienced teatchers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: It's the long-awaited day of the grand final. But before seeing the reaction of the owners and finding out their scores, each candidate will find out what the other contestants thought of their choice in terms of decoration. And it's Armand who will be the first to join our decorating expert, Valérie Damidot, in the workshop. Armand is about to discover the criticisms of his opponents. We hope for his sake that his heart is in the right place.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie reprend la route à bord de sa petite voiture rouge pour faire honneur à l’un de ses fruits favoris : la châtaigne. Julie ira à la rencontre de plusieurs producteurs en Ardèche, cuisinera la soupe traditionnelle de la région aux côtés de la pétillante Marithé. Elle fera aussi la recette des marrons glacés maison, avant de filer en Corse pour travailler la farine de châtaignes et les feuilles de son arbre. Ce périple s’achèvera comme toujours avec une recette de chef astucieuse et cette-fois ce sera Claude Brioude qui s’y collera ! Ce chef aime bousculer les codes et travaillera la châtaigne avec le poisson, deux produits de saison que l’on n’a pas forcément l’habitude de marier.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Quel bonheur de retrouver ce fruit printanier ! Les fraises redonnent des couleurs à nos assiettes et nous apportent une bonne dose de vitamines et d’antioxydants. Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo nous dévoile deux recettes sucrées autour des fraises.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pour les paresseux et tous ceux qui n’ont pas le temps, Luana Belmondo propose deux petites recettes simples et efficaces. Découvrez son pain à l'ail et au fromage, et ses spaghettis à l'ail.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 1
programme.desc: Animals represent 2/3 of the species on earth. We are increasingly concerned about our impact on the world. But what place does man have for the wild animal? Discover how it is possible to reintroduce wild animals in South Africa, or the disaster that took place with the sea lions in Namibia, and also how to preserve rhinos or other animals in biodiversity. There, women and men manage to protect wildlife every day.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll have to learn to do without oil within 20, 30 or 100 years. What will be the consequences? What are the solutions at stake? This new episode of Earth From Above attempts to answer these questions. From China to Benin, including Azerbaijan, Belgium and Canada, Earth From Above takes us on a new trip.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Pour mieux comprendre le rôle de ces montagnes explosives disséminées un peu partout sur la terre ou sous les océans, Yann Arthus-Bertrand s'est rendu en Italie, pays qui compte le plus grand nombre de volcans en activité d'Europe. Accompagné du volcanologue Jacques-Marie Bardintzeff, le photographe est allé à la rencontre de ceux qui ont choisi de vivre avec « leur » volcan, malgré les dangers que cette cohabitation comporte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Wellness cuisine is not synonymous with sadness and insipidity. It can be extremely gourmet, for a balanced way to indulge yourself. On this theme, Luana welcomes young wellness pastry chef Johanna Le Pape. Together, they will prepare recipes that are both tasty and perfectly balanced: corn pizza with vegetables and peach-cassis and verbena puffs...

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Lu Tiansen is 13 years old and lives with his family on the island of Chang Yao in China. Every Monday, Tiansen and his friends make the two-hour journey to their school, located on the mainland opposite the island. To get there on time, after their boat crossing, they take shortcuts through the rice fields to a dark tunnel. But thanks to their good humor, they always overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Yang Jiao Jiao is 11 years old and lives with her family in a village in the mountains of the Qinghai Tibetan highlands. Yang Jiao Jiao's home is 3,000 meters above sea level, while her school is in the valley. In these hostile, high-altitude regions, the journey to school is difficult. Every Monday, the children have to cross gullies, screes, rivers and steep paths, but they never give up and help each other. Along the way, they always find a way to have fun: they sing to the sun to get through the rain, they stop to pray at a temple and look after a bird.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Mabally, 13, is a Bagyeli Pygmy. The equatorial forest where he lives with his family is the only world he knows. Every term, he has to cross the jungle to reach his class. It's a three-hour walk through the slippery clay hills of southern Cameroon.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land Of Leopards
programme.desc: I viltreservatet Mashatu i Botswana, et av de siste fristedene for frittgående leoparder, føder en mor to unger. Hun vil gjøre alt for å beskytte dem. Men når klimaendringer strammer grepet, forsvinner ressurser, og en tøff leopardkrig er i emming. Denne filmen er basert på tre år med nøye observasjon, og avdekker sjeldne og utrolige bilder av oppførsel som ikke tidligere har blitt dokumentert, og tilbyr et helt nytt innblikk i motstandsdyktigheten og hemmelighetene til denne sky arten.
